lines.en: label church15:
scene urbanparadise
The trip to Yasu’s church feels a little different in the summer.
lines.zh: 夏天去 Yasu 的教堂，感觉有点不一样。

lines.en: Along with the cold comes a terrifying silence that unsettles my stomach with every sacrilegious step toward the sanctuary.
lines.zh: 寒冷带来的，是一种可怕的寂静，每朝圣所迈出一步亵渎的脚步，它就让我的胃里翻江倒海。

lines.en: But the heat of this new season masks those sounds with a soundtrack of its own.
lines.zh: 但这个新季节的酷热，用属于它自己的配乐盖住了那些声音。

lines.en: The silence has died. And in its place rests a barrage of endless insectual (A made up word not to be confused with “incestual” that pertains to the quality of being a [[or being created by an] insect) melodies-
lines.zh: 寂静已经死去。取而代之的，是无穷无尽的昆虫（一个生造的词，别跟“乱伦的”搞混，它指的是身为[[或由]昆虫所造的性质）旋律的连番轰炸——

lines.en: The creatures sing to me as if I am one of them.
lines.zh: 这些生灵对我歌唱，仿佛我是它们中的一员。

lines.en: They sing to me as if to welcome me home.
lines.zh: 它们对我歌唱，仿佛在欢迎我回家。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
And in turn, I bend my legs backward and turn them into makeshift coils, springing into the sky like the world’s largest camel cricket and coming closer to the moon than necessary.
lines.zh: 作为回应，我把双腿向后弯折，折成临时的弹簧，像世上最大的灶马一样弹向天空，离月亮比必要距离更近了一些。

lines.en: Its light reminds me of who I am and where I’ve been.
lines.zh: 它的光提醒着我，我是谁，我去过哪里。

lines.en: Its light reminds me of why I’m here and what I am to do next.
lines.zh: 它的光提醒着我，我为何在此，下一步该做什么。

lines.en: And so I take my coiled legs and unfurl them into the shapes I have grown familiar with.
lines.zh: 于是我把蜷起的双腿重新展开，摆成那些我已经熟悉的形状。

lines.en: Triangle. Circle. Triangle.
lines.zh: 三角。圆。三角。

lines.en: None of which you understand.
lines.zh: 这些你一个都不懂。

lines.en: But to me, it makes perfect sense.
lines.zh: 但对我来说，它们完全说得通。

lines.en: To me, this all makes perfect sense.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这一切都完全说得通。

lines.en: If it didn’t, I wouldn’t find myself amidst this INSECTUAL chorus with my mind half drowned in a bathtub full of honey while the rest figures out a way to float atop it.
lines.zh: 如果不是这样，我就不会身处这片“昆虫的”合唱之中，脑子一半淹在盛满蜂蜜的浴缸里，另一半还在琢磨着怎么浮到上面去。

lines.en: I come close enough to the sky that I can smell the clouds, but the putrid stench of the cumulocirrus outlines of all of the things I have lost is enough to bring me back to the ground.
lines.zh: 我离天空近到能闻见云的味道，可所有我失去的东西那积云般的轮廓所散发的腐臭，足以把我拽回地面。

lines.en: scene black
It is enough to make me seek salvation in a way much different than I am meant to.
lines.zh: 这足以让我以一种与我本该的方式截然不同的方式去寻求救赎。

lines.en: It is enough to have me curl my fingers around the handle of the door to a building in a city that houses a girl who I will one day fill with my light.
lines.zh: 这足以让我的手指蜷上门把手——那是一栋建筑的门，而这座城市里住着一个女孩，有朝一日我会用我的光把她填满。

lines.en: It is enough to remind me that I have always hated the summer.
lines.zh: 这足以让我想起，我向来憎恨夏天。

lines.en: And that I will continue to hate it until the day I die once more.
lines.zh: 而我会继续憎恨下去，直到我再死一次的那天。

lines.en: scene teaparty1

When I step inside, I am greeted by the sight of the girl I came to see electing to spend time with a colony of inanimate rabbits rather than someone actually capable of listening to her perpetual psychobabble.
lines.zh: 走进去时，映入眼帘的是我来见的那个女孩，她宁可跟一群没有生命的兔子待在一起，也不愿找一个真正能听她没完没了念叨那些疯话的人。

lines.en: Perhaps it is because they are incapable of running away like the rest of us do.
lines.zh: 也许是因为它们不像我们其他人那样会跑掉。

lines.en: Or perhaps it is because somewhere, buried beneath all of the fluff and feathers or whatever it is they stuff inside of creatures like them is something that {i}can{/i} hear.
lines.zh: 又或许是因为，在那些绒毛和羽毛之类的、人们塞进这类生灵体内的东西底下，埋着某种“{i}能{/i}”听见的东西。

lines.en: Perhaps they are creatures who {i}can{/i} feel.
lines.zh: 也许它们是“{i}能{/i}”感受的生灵。

lines.en: I mean, we’re all stuffed with something, aren’t we?
lines.zh: 我是说，我们体内也都被塞了点什么，不是吗？

lines.en: How is what’s inside of {i}us{/i} any better when {i}we’re{/i} the ones who will expire while they live on forever?
lines.zh: 既然“{i}我们{/i}”才是会腐朽的那一方，而它们会永远活下去，那“{i}我们{/i}”体内的东西又有什么更高明？

lines.en: Granted, this is all just hopeful conjecture bent into shapes that will make the girl I came to see look less damaged under the glow of the church lights.
lines.zh: 当然，这不过是些一厢情愿的臆测，被掰成各种形状，好让在教堂灯光下的那个我来见的女孩看起来没那么残破。

lines.en: Triangle. Circle. Triangle.
lines.zh: 三角。圆。三角。

lines.en: I can hear a god forming beneath the stone floor.
lines.zh: 我能听见一个神正在石板地下成形。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Penemue?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Penemue？

lines.en: : You’ve barely touched your eggs.
lines.zh: : 你的蛋几乎没动过。

lines.en: : If you don’t clear your plate, you won’t be able to come to the white room with us.
lines.zh: : 你要是不把盘子吃干净，就没法跟我们一起去白色房间。

lines.en: : That would be a terrible shame, don’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 那可太遗憾了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : And you, Wormwood. You’ve had four whole glasses of tea today. Don’t you think that may be a little much?
lines.zh: : 还有你，Wormwood。你今天已经整整喝了四杯茶了。你不觉得有点多吗？

lines.en: : If you drink any more, you’re certain to get a tummy ache. And I’m afraid I am fresh out of dried papaya to help fix you.
lines.zh: : 再喝下去，你一定会肚子疼。而我恐怕已经没有木瓜干来帮你调理了。

lines.en: : Is that so? You brought your own?
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？你自己带了？

lines.en: : My, since when are you so responsible?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你什么时候变得这么靠谱了？

lines.en: : Penemue could learn a thing or two from you.
lines.zh: : Penemue 真该跟你学学。

lines.en: I think about calling out to Yasu and putting an end to whatever weird charade this is but, at the same time, I can’t help but be fascinated by the way she speaks to them.
lines.zh: 我想出声叫住 Yasu，结束这场不知什么的古怪闹剧，可与此同时，我又忍不住被她对它们说话的方式吸引。

lines.en: It’s different than the way she communicates with people- the way she communicates with {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 那和她与人交谈的方式不同——和她与“{i}我{/i}”交谈的方式不同。

lines.en: And, for lack of a better term (And I don’t mean to sound insulting), it makes her feel...human.
lines.zh: 而且，找不到更好的说法（我也不想显得冒犯），那让她感觉……像个人。

lines.en: Much like the way her sudden interest in solo karaoke did at the Christmas party but, this time around, things actually seem to be a little {i}more{/i} depressing.
lines.zh: 就像圣诞派对上她突然迷上独自唱卡拉 OK 时那样，只不过这一次，事情看起来反而“{i}更{/i}”让人沮丧一些。

lines.en: Though, that may just be because Touka isn’t here to dampen her infinite loneliness this time and that, instead, Yasu has taken to quelling that issue in a new way. One that-
lines.zh: 不过，也许只是因为这次 Touka 不在，没人替她缓解那份无穷的孤独，于是 Yasu 换了个新方式来平息这个问题。一个——

lines.en: : How long are you going to stand there for, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你打算在那儿站多久，Sensei？

lines.en: : Haven’t you come to join the tea party?
lines.zh: : 你不是来参加茶会的吗？

lines.en: : ...I didn’t realize you knew I was here.
lines.zh: : ……我不知道你知道我在这儿。

lines.en: scene teaparty2
: The cathedral doors are rather loud. And Wormwood here hates the sound of insects that floods the room each time the doors are opened.
lines.zh: : 大教堂的门相当吵。而 Wormwood 很讨厌每次门被推开时灌进房间的虫鸣。

lines.en: : Please, sit down with us. The festivities are just getting started...and they have been looking forward to meeting you.
lines.zh: : 请跟我们一起坐吧。庆典才刚刚开始……而且它们一直很期待见到你。

lines.en: : The...stuffed animals have been looking forward to meeting me?
lines.zh: : 那些……毛绒玩具一直很期待见到我？

lines.en: scene teaparty3
: Is that what you see?
lines.zh: : 你看到的它们是这样的？

lines.en: : Well...that’s what they are. So, yes.
lines.zh: : 那个……它们本来就是啊。所以，是的。

lines.en: : Also, what festivities? Is there actually some kind of reason for this...weird cathedral tea party thing?
lines.zh: : 还有，什么庆典？这场……奇怪的大教堂茶会到底有什么由头吗？

lines.en: scene teaparty4
: There is!
lines.zh: : 有的！

lines.en: : It is our celebration of summer!
lines.zh: : 这是我们的夏日庆典！

lines.en: : A new coming of our humble god is upon us. And we have gathered here today to welcome Him and drink in His love!
lines.zh: : 我们谦卑之神的再度降临就在眼前。而我们今天聚在这里，就是为了迎接祂、痛饮祂的爱！

lines.en: : This tea was brewed with water fresh from the basement ceiling and leaves gathered from the alley behind the cathedral.
lines.zh: : 这茶是用地下室天花板上新鲜接来的水，配大教堂后巷采来的叶子泡的。

lines.en: : To become closer to God, we must partake in the pieces of Him. And in doing so, we will be granted safety, serenity, and forgiveness for the sins we have committed but have yet to realize.
lines.zh: : 要更接近神，我们就必须领受祂的碎片。如此一来，我们就能得到庇护、安宁，以及那些我们犯下却尚未察觉的罪的宽恕。

lines.en: : You gathered leaves from the alley and turned them into tea?
lines.zh: : 你从巷子里采了叶子，然后泡成了茶？

lines.en: : Not just any tea, Sensei. Tea that brings us closer to Him. Don’t you want to try?
lines.zh: : 可不是普通的茶，Sensei。是能让我们更接近祂的茶。你不想尝尝吗？

lines.en: : Wormwood has already had four cups and he is very picky when it comes to fluids. I’m sure you’ll love it as well.
lines.zh: : Wormwood 已经喝了四杯了，而他对液体可是相当挑剔的。我敢说你也会喜欢。

lines.en: : I’m good, Yasu. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，Yasu。谢谢。

lines.en: scene teaparty5
: At the very least, will you sit with us and partake in the rest of the celebration?
lines.zh: : 至少，你愿意坐下来，跟我们一起参加剩下的庆典吗？

lines.en: : Their feelings will be very hurt if you leave after coming all this way.
lines.zh: : 你大老远来了却要走，它们会很伤心的。

lines.en: : Sure. But...just to reiterate, I am not drinking your weird ceiling water tea.
lines.zh: : 行。不过……重申一遍，我可不喝你那怪兮兮的天花板水茶。

lines.en: scene black
I move to the opposite side of the table and pull out the only chair not occupied by the lifeless body of a rabbit.
lines.zh: 我走到桌子另一侧，拉出唯一一张没有被兔子那没有生命的身体占据的椅子。

lines.en: I wonder if this seat being empty means that Yasu anticipated me coming here and, if so...why?
lines.zh: 我在想，这个座位空着，是不是意味着 Yasu 预料到我会来；如果是……为什么？

lines.en: It’s not like I haven’t come here of my own volition in the past, but I’m far from being considered a regular at this point and...there was really no reason for her to believe I {i}would{/i} show up.
lines.zh: 我又不是没主动来过这儿，但眼下我远算不上什么常客，而且……她真没什么理由相信我“{i}会{/i}”出现。

lines.en: scene teaparty6
: Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu。

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : You weren’t expecting me, were you?
lines.zh: : 你不是在等我，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course I was.
lines.zh: : 我当然在等。

lines.en: : But...why?
lines.zh: : 可……为什么？

lines.en: : Because even if it is not yet apparent to you, your heart beats in tune with His.
lines.zh: : 因为即使你尚未察觉，你的心跳也和祂同频。

lines.en: : You were always going to wind up here for the celebration whether or not you knew it.
lines.zh: : 不管你知不知道，你终究会来到这里参加庆典。

lines.en: : Deep down inside, you love the summer. The same way we do.
lines.zh: : 在你内心深处，你爱夏天。就像我们一样。

lines.en: : You mean you and the rabbits?
lines.zh: : 你是说你和兔子们？

lines.en: : I suppose, if that is what makes this easier for you to understand.
lines.zh: : 要是这么说能让你更好理解，那就这么算吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think anything is going to make this easier to understand.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没什么能让我更好理解。

lines.en: : You are free to ask any questions you may have.
lines.zh: : 你尽可以问任何你想问的问题。

lines.en: : Penemue may not be in the brightest of moods today, but he is very knowledgeable when it comes to our reasons to {i}be.{/i}
lines.zh: : Penemue 今天心情可能不算最好，但说到我们“{i}存在{/i}”的理由，他可是非常博学。

lines.en: : And Wormwood is a font of information when it comes to the history of our God.
lines.zh: : 而 Wormwood 是我们神的历史的活字典。

lines.en: : There’s also Muriel...and Yomiel...and Zachariel...and many others hidden in the background who would be more than happy to hold your hand as you embark on your journey closer to us, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 还有 Muriel……Yomiel……Zachariel……以及许多藏在幕后的其他伙伴，在你踏上更靠近我们的旅途时，它们都会非常乐意牵着你的手，Sensei。

lines.en: : Again, I’m good. I’m just...here to hang out with you, really.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不用了。我只是……想来陪陪你，真的。

lines.en: : Hang out?
lines.zh: : 陪陪我？

lines.en: : Yeah. You know...spend time together. As like, friends. Or...whatever we are.
lines.zh: : 对。你知道的……一起待会儿。像，朋友那样。或者……管我们算什么。

lines.en: scene teaparty7
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 呵呵……

lines.en: : We are not friends, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们不是朋友，Sensei。

lines.en: : You know, it really hurts when you, of all people, are the one saying that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，偏偏是你来说这句话，还挺让人受伤的。

lines.en: : That isn’t to say that I don’t {i}want{/i} to be your friend. I would love that.
lines.zh: : 我并不是说我不“{i}想{/i}”做你的朋友。我求之不得。

lines.en: : But I am entirely undeserving.
lines.zh: : 可我完全配不上。

lines.en: : Besides...there’s something much more important that we have to do. Something that transcends the relationship of even lovers, let alone {i}friends.{/i}
lines.zh: : 再说……我们还有更重要的事要做。那件事超越了恋人的关系，更别提“{i}朋友{/i}”了。

lines.en: : Right. Fill the world with light or whatever.
lines.zh: : 行吧。让世界充满光什么的。

lines.en: : If only it were that simple.
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么简单就好了。

lines.en: : You see, one of my favorite things about summer is that His voice becomes much clearer.
lines.zh: : 你要明白，夏天我最喜欢的一点，就是祂的声音变得清晰多了。

lines.en: : Which means that my {i}purpose{/i} becomes much clearer in turn.
lines.zh: : 这意味着，我的“{i}使命{/i}”也相应地变得清晰多了。

lines.en: : And that purpose is?
lines.zh: : 那使命是什么？

lines.en: scene teaparty8
: Yasu?
lines.zh: : Yasu？

lines.en: : I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……

lines.en: : He doesn’t want me to tell you.
lines.zh: : 祂不想让我告诉你。

lines.en: : Okay, well...this is the last time I come to one of your tea parties.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……这大概是我最后一次来参加你的茶会了。

lines.en: : This is the last party we’ll be having for quite some time. And I’m sure you’ll have changed your mind by the time the next one comes around.
lines.zh: : 这也是我们很长一段时间里的最后一场茶会。而且我敢肯定，等下一场到来时，你已经改变主意了。

lines.en: : That is how He has envisioned it.
lines.zh: : 祂就是这样设想的。

lines.en: : That is where things will go from here.
lines.zh: : 事情也会照这样发展下去。

lines.en: : And if they don’t?
lines.zh: : 要是没照这样呢？

lines.en: : Sensei, you don’t understand.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不明白。

lines.en: : That’s just not possible.
lines.zh: : 那根本不可能。

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: scene teaparty9
: I am the one who hears the call! I am the one who witnesses His future for Him!
lines.zh: : 听见召唤的人是我！替祂见证祂未来的人是我！

lines.en: : Who plays it back like the broken record this life is!
lines.zh: : 把这段人生这枚破唱片一遍遍回放的人，是我！

lines.en: : He knows what will happen because it has happened before!
lines.zh: : 祂知道将会发生什么，因为它曾经发生过！

lines.en: : It will happen again!
lines.zh: : 它会再次发生！

lines.en: : Summer has come, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 夏天已经来了，Sensei！

lines.en: : He sleeps no longer!
lines.zh: : 祂不再沉睡！

lines.en: : Enlighten him, Wormwood!
lines.zh: : 点化他吧，Wormwood！

lines.en: : Yasu, I’m not going to talk to-
lines.zh: : Yasu，我不会去跟——

lines.en: scene teaparty10
: To build a wall or break one down;\nIt depends on what you want.
lines.zh:
: 是筑起一道墙，还是推倒一道墙；
全看你想要什么。

lines.en: : To see a world outside of mirrors;\nOr bathe in holy fonts.
lines.zh:
: 是看见镜子之外的世界；
还是沐浴在圣水盆里。

lines.en: : We all have things that we must do;\nYou, too, must fill your role.
lines.zh:
: 我们都有必须去做的事；
你也必须扮演你的角色。

lines.en: : For if you don’t, we {i}all{/i} will fall;\nFurther down the rabbit hole.
lines.zh:
: 因为如果你不这么做，我们“{i}所有人{/i}”都会坠落；
更深地掉进兔子洞里。

lines.en: scene teaparty11
: Feel the caress of the wind as it slips in through the sleeves of your shirt! This is Him!
lines.zh: : 感受风从你衬衫袖口钻进来时的抚摸吧！这就是祂！

lines.en: : The undeniable solemnity you feel when gazing up at your ceiling! The one that does not leak! This is Him!
lines.zh: : 抬头凝望自家天花板时，那种无可否认的肃穆！那块不漏水的天花板！这就是祂！

lines.en: : The shaking of the trees! The creaking of the floorboards! It is all Him!
lines.zh: : 树木的摇晃！地板的吱呀！全都是祂！

lines.en: : He is all around us!
lines.zh: : 祂就在我们周围！

lines.en: : He is in me!
lines.zh: : 祂在我体内！

lines.en: : I can feel him bursting out like a possessed holy embryo with fingernails growing at twenty times the rate of that of a normal human being!
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到祂像一具被附体的神圣胚胎般破体而出，指甲以常人二十倍的速度疯长！

lines.en: : He claws His way out!
lines.zh: : 祂正抓挠着爬出来！

lines.en: : Can you see Him?
lines.zh: : 你能看见祂吗？

lines.en: : He wants to emerge!
lines.zh: : 祂想要降临！

lines.en: : CAN YOU SEE HIM?!
lines.zh: : 你能看见祂吗？！

lines.en: scene teaparty12
: Don’t answer His questions with responses you know not to be true.
lines.zh: : 别用你自己都知道不真实的答案去回答祂的问题。

lines.en: : Not after all He has done for you.
lines.zh: : 尤其是在祂为你做了这一切之后。

lines.en: : See...that’s just the thing.
lines.zh: : 你看……问题就在这儿。

lines.en: : He has done {i}nothing{/i} for me.
lines.zh: : 祂从来没为我做过“{i}任何{/i}”事。

lines.en: : No {i}god{/i} has ever done anything for me. They’re all just stories that people latch onto so they can have something to look forward to when they die.
lines.zh: : 从来没有哪个“{i}神{/i}”为我做过什么。它们都只是人们抓来靠着的故事，好让自己在死的时候还有点盼头。

lines.en: : Or...something they force themselves to believe in so they can have some sort of code to live by.
lines.zh: : 或者……是他们强迫自己去信的东西，好给自己弄一套活下去的准则。

lines.en: : But none of them are real. Yours included.
lines.zh: : 可它们没有一个是真的。你的神也一样。

lines.en: : But hey, if you want to waste away your days talking to stuffed animals instead of people, that’s fine. I’ve got no right to tell you how to live your life.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你要是想把日子浪费在跟毛绒玩具而不是活人说话上，那是你的自由。我没资格教你该怎么活。

lines.en: : But you should stop trying to make me live {i}mine{/i} the way you do by shoving these stories down my throat every time I come here.
lines.zh: : 但你不该每次我来这儿都硬把这些故事往我喉咙里塞，逼我按你的方式去过“{i}我{/i}”的人生。

lines.en: scene teaparty13
: But, Sensei-
lines.zh: : 可是，Sensei——

lines.en: : You wouldn’t come here at all if you didn’t long for the sensation of something stuck inside of your throat.
lines.zh: : 要不是你渴望着有某种东西卡在喉咙里的感觉，你根本不会来这儿。

lines.en: : What difference does it make if it is the word of the lord or the tongue of the one He brought back?
lines.zh: : 那究竟是主的话语，还是祂带回之人舌头，又有什么区别呢？

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 那个……什么？

lines.en: scene teaparty14
: Heheh...hahahahahahHH!H!H!H!HAHAHAHAHuiywegfdiusdhfiuodghfuohasdifougdhsa!!
lines.zh: : 呵呵……哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！！！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈uiywegfdiusdhfiuodghfuohasdifougdhsa！！

lines.en: : YOU KNOW IT TO BE TRUE! WHICH IS WHY YOUR DENIAL NOW IS STRONGER THAN EVER BEFORE!
lines.zh: : 你心里明知那是真的！所以你此刻的否认才比以往任何时候都更强烈！

lines.en: : YOU HAVE NOT JUST {i}SEEN{/i} HIM AT THIS POINT!
lines.zh: : 到这一步，你已不只是“{i}看见{/i}”过祂！

lines.en: : YOU HAVE BEEN {i}TOUCHED{/i} BY HIM!
lines.zh: : 你还被祂“{i}触碰{/i}”过！

lines.en: : I CAN SMELL HIS SCENT ALL OVER YOU! THE ONE TRUE APHRODISIAC! CLINGING TO THE FABRIC OF YOUR COAT AND MAKING ME FEEL WAYS I HAVE SELDOM FELT BEFORE!
lines.zh: : 我能闻到你满身都是祂的气味！那唯一的真·催情香！它黏在你外套的布料上，让我体会到前所未有的感觉！

lines.en: : COME TO ME! COME TO ME IN YOUR PUREST FORM!
lines.zh: : 到我这儿来！以你最纯净的形态到我这儿来！

lines.en: : COME TO ME BEFORE ALL OF MY FRIENDS IN THE HOUSE OF MY FATHER AND RUB HIS SCENT ON ME!
lines.zh: : 在我父的殿里、在我所有朋友面前到我这儿来，把祂的气味抹到我身上！

lines.en: : RUB HIS SCENT ON ME!
lines.zh: : 把祂的气味抹到我身上！

lines.en: : RUB HIS SCENT ON-
lines.zh: : 把祂的气味抹到——

lines.en: scene teaparty15
: NGH!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊！

lines.en: Yasu winds up screaming at me so loudly that she gives herself a headache.
lines.zh: Yasu 冲我喊得太大声，最后把自己喊出了头痛。

lines.en: Which, at this point in time, I can safely say is probably the best thing that has happened to me today.
lines.zh: 而在眼下这个时间点，我可以放心地说，这大概是我今天遇到的最好的事。

lines.en: Or, at least it would be if I wasn’t actually worried about her health right now as it seems this might actually be kind of serious.
lines.zh: 或者说，要不是我现在真的担心她的身体状况——因为这看起来可能还挺严重——那确实会是最好的事。

lines.en: : Uhh...religious stuff aside, are you okay? Because it looks like-
lines.zh: : 呃……宗教的事先放一边，你还好吗？因为看起来——

lines.en: scene teaparty14
: I am fine! This is nothing in the face of all He has felt!
lines.zh: : 我很好！跟祂所感受过的一切相比，这根本算不了什么！

lines.en: : Please help yourself to some of Penemue’s eggs, Sensei! Partake in the bountiful feast He has provided us! One that transcends time itself!
lines.zh: : 请随意享用 Penemue 的蛋吧，Sensei！领受祂为我们摆下的这场超越时间本身的丰盛盛宴！

lines.en: : Reserve your space in the white room! There is nowhere else that can protect us from-
lines.zh: : 在白色房间里预留你的位置吧！没有别的地方能保护我们免受——

lines.en: scene teaparty16
: AAAAHHH! IT HURTS!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！好痛！

lines.en: : IT HURTS, IT HURTS, IT HURTS!
lines.zh: : 好痛，好痛，好痛！

lines.en: scene teaparty14
: It doesn’t hurt at all!
lines.zh: : 一点都不痛！

lines.en: : It feels better than anything I’ve ever felt before!
lines.zh: : 这感觉比我以往感受过的任何东西都好！

lines.en: : Come to me!
lines.zh: : 到我这儿来！

lines.en: : Come! Come! Come!
lines.zh: : 来！来！来！

lines.en: scene teaparty10
: A LIE, A LIE, ALIGN!;\nTHE STARS BENEATH THE SKY!
lines.zh:
: 谎言，谎言，列成行！；
苍穹之下的群星！

lines.en: : CHERISH THOSE WHO LOVE THEM AND RELINQUISH YOUR CONTROL!
lines.zh: : 珍爱那些爱它们的人，交出你的掌控！

lines.en: : FEEL HIS GIFTS! RETURN HIS LOVE!
lines.zh: : 领受祂的恩赐！回报祂的爱！

lines.en: : CLIMB FURTHER DOWN THE RABBIT HOLE!
lines.zh: : 继续往兔子洞深处爬！

lines.en: scene teaparty17
: Okay. It’s time we get you back to-
lines.zh: : 好了。我们该送你回——

lines.en: : Yasu?
lines.zh: : Yasu？

lines.en: scene black
When I turn back around, it’s like she was never here at all.
lines.zh: 我转回身时，她就像从来没在这儿过一样。

lines.en: Yasu, the rabbits, and all of the tea had vanished into thin air.
lines.zh: Yasu、兔子们，还有所有的茶，全都凭空消失了。

lines.en: All that was left was a table, some chairs, and a plate full of eggs.
lines.zh: 只剩下一张桌子、几把椅子，和一盘满满的蛋。

lines.en: I chalked it up to another delusion and headed home.
lines.zh: 我把这归结为又一次幻觉，然后回家了。

lines.en: The sound of insects along the way was louder than ever before.
lines.zh: 一路上，虫鸣比以往任何时候都更响。

lines.en: When I got into bed that night, it felt as if my legs had been broken.
lines.zh: 那晚躺到床上时，我感觉自己的腿像是被打断了。

lines.en: Or, at the very least, bent backwards.
lines.zh: 或者至少，是被向后折断了。

lines.zh: {i}Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]！{/i}
